subject: Markdown-rendered HTML file not showing Table of Contents

messages.author: c024244300a6485c
messages.subject: Markdown-rendered HTML file not showing Table of Contents
parts:
I am trying to include a simple markdown file in my shiny app (see attached).

If the knitted HTML file is not self contained, including via includeHTML("cppdoc.html") results in a lacking table of contents (although it appears in the local html file).

If the knitted HTML file is self-contained,  including the knitted html file via includeHTML("cppdoc.html") works as it should but my plotlyOutput navbarpages do not load.

Including the markdown file via includeMarkdown("cppdoc.Rmd") results in an unformatted document.

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Best,
Max
